description: "Janet McLaren, the Faithful Nurse" by W.H.G. Kingston is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story unfolds around the Morrison family, who face profound loss and hardship after both parents succumb to an epidemic, leaving their three children—Margaret, David, and Donald—in the care of their devoted nurse, Janet.
